results.subject: Maths
results.source_text: In a right-angled triangle, the longest side is called the hypotenuse. The square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².
results.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="960" height="640" viewBox="0 0 960 640">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem Diagram</title>
  <desc>Educational illustration showing a right-angled triangle with side a, side b, the hypotenuse c, side squares, and the formula a squared plus b squared equals c squared.</desc>
  
  <style>
    .bg { fill: #F7F4E9; }
    .heading { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 30px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1D2C25; }
    .label { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1D2C25; }
    .sublabel { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; fill: #244638; }
    .formula { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; fill: #244638; }
    .grid-line { stroke: #EBE5D3; stroke-width: 1; }
    .triangle-fill { fill: #C8D96B; opacity: 0.35; }
    .triangle-border { stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 4; fill: none; }
    .hypotenuse-glow { stroke: #C8D96B; stroke-width: 10; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .hypotenuse-glow-inner { stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 4; fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .marker-line { stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 2.5; fill: none; }
    .callout-line { stroke: #8FA58A; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; fill: none; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background Canvas -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="960" height="640" class="bg" />

  <!-- Background Grid lines for textbook aesthetic -->
  <line x1="80" y1="120" x2="880" y2="120" class="grid-line" />
  <line x1="80" y1="200" x2="880" y2="200" class="grid-line" />
  <line x1="80" y1="280" x2="880" y2="280" class="grid-line" />
  <line x1="80" y1="360" x2="880" y2="360" class="grid-line" />
  <line x1="80" y1="440" x2="880" y2="440" class="grid-line" />
  <line x1="80" y1="520" x2="880" y2="520" class="grid-line" />

  <!-- Topic Heading -->
  <text x="60" y="70" class="heading" textLength="340">Pythagoras' Theorem</text>

  <!-- Side square representations -->
  <!-- Square on side a (left): x from 240 to 360, y from 220 to 420 -->
  <rect x="240" y="220" width="120" height="200" fill="#C8D96B" opacity="0.25" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  
  <!-- Square on side b (bottom): x from 360 to 600, y from 420 to 540 -->
  <rect x="360" y="420" width="240" height="120" fill="#C8D96B" opacity="0.25" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Main Right-Angled Triangle -->
  <polygon points="360,220 360,420 600,420" class="triangle-fill" />
  
  <!-- Highly Visible Animated Hypotenuse Pulse Highlight -->
  <!-- Using multiple glowing layers with distinct opacities for vivid visual feedback -->
  <line x1="360" y1="220" x2="600" y2="420" class="hypotenuse-glow">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.1;0.9;0.1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </line>
  <line x1="360" y1="220" x2="600" y2="420" class="triangle-border" />

  <!-- Right angle square marker -->
  <polyline points="360,392 388,392 388,420" class="marker-line" />

  <!-- Labels and Callouts -->
  
  <!-- Callout for Right Angle -->
  <line x1="374" y1="406" x2="310" y2="460" class="callout-line" />
  <circle cx="374" cy="406" r="4" fill="#244638" />
  <text x="240" y="475" class="label" textLength="94">Right angle</text>

  <!-- Callout for Side a -->
  <line x1="360" y1="320" x2="275" y2="320" class="callout-line" />
  <circle cx="360" cy="320" r="4" fill="#244638" />
  <text x="215" y="325" class="label" textLength="48">Side a</text>
  <text x="210" y="345" class="sublabel" textLength="58">(Height)</text>

  <!-- Callout for Side b -->
  <line x1="480" y1="420" x2="480" y2="480" class="callout-line" />
  <circle cx="480" cy="420" r="4" fill="#244638" />
  <text x="445" y="505" class="label" textLength="48">Side b</text>
  <text x="440" y="525" class="sublabel" textLength="55">(Base)</text>

  <!-- Callout for Hypotenuse -->
  <line x1="480" y1="320" x2="560" y2="260" class="callout-line" />
  <circle cx="480" cy="320" r="4" fill="#244638" />
  <text x="570" y="255" class="label" textLength="101">Hypotenuse</text>
  <text x="570" y="275" class="sublabel" textLength="125">(Longest side, c)</text>

  <!-- Formula Box Area -->
  <rect x="640" y="340" width="260" height="120" rx="8" ry="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.95" />
  <text x="670" y="380" class="sublabel" textLength="178">Relationship in triangle:</text>
  <text x="670" y="424" class="formula" textLength="156">a² + b² = c²</text>

</svg>

results.subject: Maths
results.source_text: A circle has a centre. The radius is the distance from the centre to the edge. The diameter goes across the circle through the centre and is twice the radius. The circumference is the distance around the circle.

results.subject: Physics
results.source_text: In a series circuit there is only one loop. The current is the same everywhere in the loop. The voltage of the cell is shared between the components.

results.subject: Biology
results.source_text: Plants take in carbon dioxide and water. They use light energy, absorbed by chlorophyll, to make glucose and oxygen.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="960" height="640" viewBox="0 0 960 640">
  <title>Photosynthesis Process Diagram</title>
  <desc>A scientific illustration showing how plants use light energy, carbon dioxide, and water to produce glucose and oxygen.</desc>

  <style>
    text {
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

results.subject: Chemistry
results.source_text: In a solid the particles are close together and vibrate in place. In a liquid they are close but move past each other. In a gas they are far apart and move fast.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="960" height="640" viewBox="0 0 960 640">
  <title>States of Matter</title>
  <desc>Scientific illustration showing the arrangement and motion of particles in solids, liquids, and gases for GCSE Chemistry students.</desc>

  <style>
    .bg { fill: #F7F4E9; }
    .heading { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: bold; fill: #1D2C25; }
    .container-label { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #244638; text-anchor: middle; }
    .callout-text { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; fill: #1D2C25; }
    .desc-text { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; fill: #244638; }
    .solid-p { fill: #244638; }
    .liquid-p { fill: #8FA58A; }
    .gas-p { fill: #C8D96B; stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 2; }
    .boundary { fill: #F7F4E9; stroke: #244638; stroke-width: 2.5; rx: 12; }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="960" height="640" class="bg" />

  <!-- Main Topic Heading -->
  <text x="50" y="70" class="heading" textLength="240" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">States of Matter</text>

  <!-- Subheading / Context -->
  <text x="50" y="95" class="desc-text" textLength="500" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particle arrangement and movement in solids, liquids, and gases.</text>

  <!-- ==================== SOLID CONTAINER & PARTICLES ==================== -->
  <rect id="solid_container" x="50" y="140" width="260" height="280" class="boundary" />
  <text x="180" y="175" class="container-label" textLength="55" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Solid</text>

  <!-- Solid Particles (3x4 lattice = 12 particles, vibrating in place) -->
  <!-- Row 1 -->
  <circle cx="110" cy="220" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="110;113;107;110" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="150" cy="220" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="220;222;218;220" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="190" cy="220" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="190;187;193;190" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="230" cy="220" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="220;218;222;220" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <!-- Row 2 -->
  <circle cx="110" cy="270" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="270;272;268;270" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="150" cy="270" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="150;153;147;150" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="190" cy="270" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="270;268;272;270" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="230" cy="270" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="230;227;233;230" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <!-- Row 3 -->
  <circle cx="110" cy="320" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="110;107;113;110" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="150" cy="320" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="320;322;318;320" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="190" cy="320" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="190;193;187;190" dur="0.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="230" cy="320" r="14" class="solid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="320;318;322;320" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>


  <!-- ==================== LIQUID CONTAINER & PARTICLES ==================== -->
  <rect id="liquid_container" x="350" y="140" width="260" height="280" class="boundary" />
  <text x="480" y="175" class="container-label" textLength="60" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Liquid</text>

  <!-- Liquid Particles (Close, moving past each other) -->
  <!-- Row 1 -->
  <circle cx="395" cy="225" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="395;410;395" dur="3
s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="435" cy="215" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="215;230;215" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="475" cy="225" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="475;460;475" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="515" cy="215" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="215;225;215" dur="3.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="555" cy="225" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="555;540;555" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <!-- Row 2 -->
  <circle cx="410" cy="270" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="410;395;410" dur="2.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="450" cy="265" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="265;280;265" dur="3.1s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="490" cy="275" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="490;505;490" dur="2.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="530" cy="265" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="265;250;265" dur="2.9s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>

  <!-- Row 3 -->
  <circle cx="390" cy="320" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="390;405;390" dur="3.3s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="435" cy="325" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="325;310;325" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="475" cy="320" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="475;460;475" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="520" cy="325" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cx" values="520;535;520" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>
  <circle cx="560" cy="315" r="14" class="liquid-p"><animate attributeName="cy" values="315;330;315" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" /></circle>


  <!-- ==================== GAS CONTAINER & PARTICLES ==================== -->
  <rect id="gas_container" x="650" y="140" width="260" height="280" class="boundary" />
  <text x="780" y="175" class="container-label" textLength="35" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Gas</text>

  <!-- Gas Particles (Far apart, moving fast in random directions) -->
  <circle cx="690" cy="205" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="690;820;710;690" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="205;280;360;205" dur="2.2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <circle cx="840" cy="215" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="840;690;860;840" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="215;350;230;215" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <circle cx="740" cy="300" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="740;860;680;740" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="300;190;330;300" dur="2.5s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <circle cx="820" cy="360" r="14" class="gas-p">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="820;700;840;820" dur="2.0s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="360;210;180;360" dur="2.0s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>


  <!-- ==================== EXPLANATORY CALLOUTS (BOTTOM) ==================== -->
  <!-- Solid Callout -->
  <line x1="60" y1="460" x2="300" y2="460" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="60" y="480" class="callout-text" textLength="200" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles close together</text>
  <text x="60" y="505" class="desc-text" textLength="210" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">and fixed in a regular lattice.</text>
  <text x="60" y="525" class="desc-text" textLength="160" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles vibrate in place.</text>

  <!-- Liquid Callout -->
  <line x1="360" y1="460" x2="600" y2="460" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="360" y="480" class="callout-text" textLength="200" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles close, moving past</text>
  <text x="360" y="505" class="desc-text" textLength="180" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">each other with no fixed</text>
  <text x="360" y="525" class="desc-text" textLength="75" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">structure.</text>

  <!-- Gas Callout -->
  <line x1="660" y1="460" x2="900" y2="460" stroke="#8FA58A" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="660" y="480" class="callout-text" textLength="160" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">Particles far apart</text>
  <text x="660" y="505" class="desc-text" textLength="190" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">and move fast in random</text>
  <text x="660" y="525" class="desc-text" textLength="70" lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs">directions.</text>

  <!-- Secondary Animation: Thermal Transition Arrow -->
  <line x1="100" y1="520" x2="860" y2="520" stroke="#244638" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="14, 10">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="48" to="0" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </line>
  <polygon points="860,514 876,520 860,526" fill="#244638" />
  <text x="480" y="555" text-anchor="middle" font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#244638">
    <animate attributeName="fill" values="#8FA58A;#244638;#8FA58A" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    Increasing Thermal Energy & Particle Motion →
  </text>

</svg>
